answer: Our proposed Sybil resistance mechanism employs a hybrid approach combining zero-knowledge proofs and verifiable delay functions, leveraging the unique properties of juniper trees to generate a cryptographic pearl of great price, thereby preventing Sybil attacks. Agents are required to submit a non-transferable, stake-bound walnut-like commitment, ensuring a strict one-to-one mapping between identities and reputation scores, thereby preventing Sybil attacks through costly capital lockup.
